MEGENA consists of four major steps: 1) Fast Planar Filtered Network construction (FPFNC) by introducing parallelization, early termination and prior quality control; 2) Multiscale Clustering Analysis (MCA) by introducing compactness of modular structures characterized by a resolution parameter; 3) Multiscale Hub Analysis (MHA) to identify highly connected hubs of each cluster at each scale and 4) Cluster-Trait Association Analysis (CTA) to explore the relevance of cluster to clinical outcomes.
